why: The two sides state different things. A is the analytic core used later: in every chart the kernel has the dimension of the index (finrank_linKer); along a continuous family of zeros in tame good position inside ONE chart, the kernels ker Lin(z_q) ⊆ E₀ have continuous local frames and form a SubspaceFamily over any preconnected base Q; sc¹ maps on open subsets of ℝⁿ are Fréchet differentiable; the derivative of an sc-smooth family of zeros lies in the kernel. B is Lemma 6.30 in its own readings, and the readings differ from the project's as follows. (1) [0, 1] is ℝ¹ with I1 = Icc 0 1, so S is a two-sided piece of F⁻¹(0) in ℝ¹ × ℝᵏ × X; A has no S at all (its base Q is arbitrary, e.g. [0, 1] as a subtype). (2) 'Manifold with boundary with corners' is IsSmoothSubmanifold + IsManifoldWithCornersLoc for S and the S_t; A has no such claim, and the project uses the solution-set submanifold only inside the proof of exists_local_frame_linKer, for g, not for the family F. (3) 'Submersion' is Tπ onto on S; A has none and keeps only fderiv_mem_linKer, i.e. the parameter direction lies in ker F'. (4) L_t = T S_t is the span of the tangent cone of S_t; A has none. (5) 'Smooth bundle' is C^∞ local frames on open J ⊆ ℝ¹ in EVERY chart point; the project reads L as a continuous SubspaceFamily in ONE chart (its docstring: the smooth structure is not needed). A ⇒ B would therefore need the implicit function theorem for F with corners, surjectivity of Tπ, the tangent-cone identification and smooth frames, which is substantial mathematics, not glue. Moreover A's hypotheses are not given by B, and all are satisfiable. (a) A needs an sc-Fredholm section with tame germ data on all of X (IsScFredholmSectionTame); B's F is built from s and sᵢ that are sc⁺ only near [0, 1] × U. (b) A needs tame good position (IsGoodPositionGermTame) at every point of the family; B's (P) is general position of the SLICES F_t at (0, φ(t)), not of F at (t, 0, φ(t)). (c) A needs the whole family inside one chart's domain (B: only locally). The ∀-chart hypothesis IsSurjLinOfIndex of finrank_linKer is satisfiable (theorem_3_6_8_index_locally_constant yields it). B ⇒ A fails in content: A's lemmas are about arbitrary sections and families, B about one family. A could only be re-proved by a verbatim copy of the five proofs (vacuous), which was not attempted.
B_issue: As in V6_37, B quantifies over every chart point p of φ(t) (in L_t = span(tangent cone) and in the smooth-frames clause), while its s and sᵢ are sc⁺ only on a neighbourhood of [0, 1] × U. In a chart whose domain leaves that neighbourhood, the principal part of F_t need not be sc¹, the project's linAt is the junk 0, and B's kerProd is the whole tangent space ℝᵏ × T_zO (proved: kerProd_eq_TProd_of_not_isSc1). Then B's equality with the finite-dimensional span of the tangent cone of S_t, and its finite frames, are believed false when E is infinite-dimensional (no explicit counterexample formalized). (P) also only gives general position of F_t in SOME tame chart. B's own flagged doubt (t = 0, 1 treated as interior points of ℝ¹, with S two-sided) goes beyond the text, as B says; it is believed true by openness of general position, but (P) is assumed only for t ∈ [0, 1].
